verdict.rationale: Render documents load-based autoscaling that handles "100x traffic bursts and beyond" (render-docs-11), and a community user confirms it supports autoscaling (render-comm-1), so the scaling half of the story is partly covered. Nothing in the evidence addresses instance boot or cold-start times, and nothing shows scaling to tens of thousands of instances. Missing for 10: evidence of sub-second instance boot, documented scale ceilings reaching tens of thousands of instances, independent benchmarks of scaling under load.
